completion_guard.scope: Completion guard only; timer/wall/frame observations do not establish an FPS or performance acceptance criterion.

scope: One authored SFC 1F↔2F physical conveyor pair and representative hotel4F gym. Recorded test starts, actual production movement and E, no body writes during carry. Geometry/ramp support, neutral passenger ascent/descent, pause, landing/dismount, new station distinct meshes and seated joint motion, per-kind progress, blocked return/retry, original treadmill/dumbbell regression and unchanged capsule/exterior inventory. Native screenshots only when renderer is available. The completion guard is separate from functional thresholds; neither timeout nor PASS is an FPS/performance acceptance. Not a surveyed real building layout, all-room action audit or human feel acceptance.
